store_policies.return_policy_general: Returns require 95% of original atomic mass and a valid interdimensional receipt. Items that have achieved sentience cannot be returned, only negotiated with.
store_policies.biohazard_waiver: All customers must sign the Corporate Bio-Hazard Waiver (Form 12-Zorg) before handling Tier 3+ unstable products. Cosmo Mart is not liable for temporal displacement, minor limb regrowth, or existential dread.
store_policies.payment_methods: We accept Galactic Credits, Bartered Memories, and (reluctantly) Earth currency at a 40% markup.
store_policies.store_hours: Open during all planetary rotations except the Void Tuesdays observed every third lunar cycle.
store_policies.employee_discount_policy: Employees receive 12% off, except on sentient items, which is against labor code 7.2.
store_policies.gleb_work_experience: Gleb works 14-hour orbital shifts across 3 simultaneous timelines. Gleb loves helping organic beings but dislikes when customers try to pay with expired temporal vouchers or step on Greg the Doormat.
store_policies.breakroom_rules: Do not leave unobserved quantum food in the staff fridge. Items left past Friday will evolve culture and claim squatter rights.
store_policies.hazard_escalation: If an item begins opening localized wormholes or emitting high-frequency telepathic screams, contact Gleb immediately for emergency stabilization.

products.atomic_mass_stability: Stable (rehydrate within 3 cycles or it achieves consciousness)
products.description: A butter substitute harvested from the empty space between stars. Rehydrate with tears for best flavor.
common_customer_complaints: Melted into a small black hole on my counter
Now speaks to me in my sleep
Tastes like regret
products.interactive_components_hazards: Do NOT rehydrate with liquid nitrogen. Localized gravity well may form within 2 meters.
products.item_specific_return_policy: No returns once rehydrated. Unrehydrated units accepted with 95% mass and no gravitational anomalies.

products.atomic_mass_stability: Unstable — exists in superposition until observed
products.description: Each egg is simultaneously delicious and inedible until you look directly at it. Best served with a side of certainty.
common_customer_complaints: Ate it and didn't taste anything until Thursday
My spoon disappeared
Egg count changes every time I recheck the jar
products.interactive_components_hazards: Direct eye contact required before consumption. Do not consume while blinking.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Cannot be returned in an unobserved state. Schrödinger's Refund Clause applies.

products.description: Replacement tendons for the modern multi-limbed professional. Snaps back with 6x the force of Earth rubber bands.
common_customer_complaints: Launched my coworker across the breakroom
Now permanently attached to the doorframe
Whistles ominously in high wind
products.interactive_components_hazards: HIGH SNAP-BACK RISK. Safety goggles mandatory (sold separately, aisle 9). Do not exceed 400% elongation.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable if cable has not been surgically implanted.

products.description: A doormat with a rudimentary consciousness and strong feelings about muddy boots. Judges you gently.
common_customer_complaints: Refuses to let in guests it dislikes
Asked for a name change
Filed a labor complaint against my household
products.interactive_components_hazards: Do not step on Greg with intent to disrespect. Passive-aggressive static shock possible.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Non-returnable per Sentient Goods Protection Act, Section 4. You may rehome Greg at Customer Service.

products.description: Chips that float toward the nearest source of joy. Great for parties, terrible for solemn occasions.
common_customer_complaints: Chips floated into a funeral and ruined the mood
Bag won't stay closed, chips escape at night
Attracted by my neighbor's joy instead of mine
products.interactive_components_hazards: Keep sealed away from open ceiling vents. Minor levitation of nearby unsecured objects possible.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable only if bag is still sealed and chips have not achieved escape velocity.

products.description: A pocket-sized shortcut through spacetime. Great for skipping laundry day. Do not use for commuting to work; HR frowns on time-based excuses.
common_customer_complaints: Lost my left sock and possibly my left shoe dimension
Arrived 3 days before I left
Cat went in, different cat came out
products.interactive_components_hazards: EXTREME HAZARD. Requires signed Bio-Hazard Waiver (Form 12-Zorg). Do not operate near pets, children, or ex-partners.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Non-returnable once activated. Unopened units returnable within one temporal cycle (approx. 6 Earth days).

products.description: Reads your emotions and responds with mild, geologically-paced encouragement. Very patient. Very slow.
common_customer_complaints: Took 3 weeks to respond to my crisis
Now I feel emotionally inferior to a rock
Judged my life choices in complete silence
products.interactive_components_hazards: None, unless thrown. Rock does not consent to being thrown.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable within 30 cycles, rock must be in original emotional state.

products.description: Worn daily by Cosmo Mart staff to reach high shelves. Now available with 30% more foot smell as a complimentary feature.
common_customer_complaints: Drifted into the ceiling during a sneeze
Can't turn off, been on the ceiling since Tuesday
Smell has developed its own gravitational pull
products.interactive_components_hazards: Do not sneeze while wearing. Ceiling collision risk in rooms under 3 meters.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Final sale. Employee floor models are not eligible for return, only pity.

products.description: Genetically altered broccoli that absorbs light and glows purple. Tastes like garlic and battery acid.
common_customer_complaints: Made my tongue glow in the dark
Tried to connect to my home Wi-Fi
products.interactive_components_hazards: Steam before eating to neutralize electrical pulses.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable if un-steamed and not yet paired with Bluetooth.

products.description: Cultured steak harvested from solar flare energy. Sizzles loudly even when raw.
common_customer_complaints: Melted my frying pan
Cooked itself in the grocery bag
products.interactive_components_hazards: Use silicon tongs. Keep away from flammable kitchen aprons.
products.item_specific_return_policy: No returns if reduced to pure ash.

products.description: Ice cream chilled so severely that it pauses local time for 3 seconds with every bite.
common_customer_complaints: Brain freeze lasted 4 space-cycles
Spoon froze to my tongue
products.interactive_components_hazards: Eat with insulated gloves. Do not refreeze after melting.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Non-returnable once liquid.

products.description: Infinitely stretchable gummy worms containing tiny dense cores. Sour apple flavor.
common_customer_complaints: Stuck to the roof of my mouth and warped space
Bag weighs 300 lbs when dropped
products.interactive_components_hazards: Chew thoroughly to prevent intestinal gravity spikes.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable only in original anti-gravity packaging.

products.description: Made from genuine pulverized space debris and marshmallow moons. Stays crunchy in milk for 400 years.
common_customer_complaints: Broke three alien molars
Marshmallows started orbiting the milk bowl
products.interactive_components_hazards: Eat slowly. May cause magnetic teeth.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable within 14 days if box is unopened.

products.description: Bacon that changes flavor depending on what you're thinking about while cooking it.
common_customer_complaints: Thought about my taxes, bacon tasted like paper
Bacon turned into sausage mid-flip
products.interactive_components_hazards: Maintain positive thoughts while frying.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable only if uncooked and in baseline pig form.

products.description: Hot sauce brewed in the upper atmosphere of Venus. Scoville rating: 12,000,000.
common_customer_complaints: Dissolved my porcelain plate

products.interactive_components_hazards: Store in lead-lined bottles. Avoid contact with skin.
products.item_specific_return_policy: No returns on opened bottles.

products.description: Grapes grown in zero-G lunar greenhouses. They float out of the bowl if not weighted down.
common_customer_complaints: Grapes escaped into the ceiling fan
Too shiny to eat in the dark
products.interactive_components_hazards: Keep bowl covered with heavy napkin.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable if all grapes are retrieved from ceiling.

products.description: Coffee beans so strong a single cup allows you to see 5 seconds into the future.
common_customer_complaints: Saw myself spilling the coffee before I spilled it
Haven't slept since last leap year
products.interactive_components_hazards: Do not drink more than 1 shot per planetary cycle.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable only if beans remain unground.

products.description: Tofu that absorbs the exact flavor you wish it had. Requires active mental focus.
common_customer_complaints: Got distracted, tasted like anxiety
Refused to absorb flavor from non-vegetarians
products.interactive_components_hazards: Clear your mind before cooking.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable within 7 days.

products.description: Popping candy that creates tiny sonic booms in your mouth.

products.description: Popsicles crafted from compressed northern lights. Colors change as you lick.
common_customer_complaints: Stained my tongue blue, green, and ultraviolet
Melted into a glowing puddle
products.interactive_components_hazards: Store below -20°C.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable if frozen solid.

products.description: 100% marshmallow cereal bits with high sugar-to-mass ratio.
common_customer_complaints: Instant sugar crash sent me into hyper-sleep

products.interactive_components_hazards: Keep away from hyperactive alien younglings.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable within 14 days.

products.description: Dried jerky from deep-space kraken reserves. Spicy, smoky, and slightly squirmy.

Too tough for standard human molars
products.interactive_components_hazards: Chew thoroughly before swallowing.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable if unopened.

products.description: Peppers that pass through solid matter until bitten.

products.item_specific_return_policy: Non-returnable if lost in floorboards.

products.description: Gives you 72 hours of energy by annihilating tiny particles inside your gut.
common_customer_complaints: Cleaned my entire space station at 3 AM
Heart beats in rhythm with galactic core
products.interactive_components_hazards: Do not shake can before opening.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Unopened cans accepted within 7 days.

products.description: Half the box tastes like your favorite childhood memory; the other half tastes like your next birthday.
common_customer_complaints: Ate a future chocolate and found out I get fired

products.interactive_components_hazards: Do not consume whole box in one sitting.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable only if temporal seals are intact.

products.description: Chips that change texture from crispy to liquid to solid as you chew.

products.interactive_components_hazards: May cause temporary sensory stuttering.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable within 30 days.

products.description: A dense cheese wheel that emits a warm, comfortable yellow radiation glow.
common_customer_complaints: Melted through plastic wrapper
Attracted small metal utensils
products.interactive_components_hazards: Store in lead cheese-keeper.
products.item_specific_return_policy: Returnable with 95% mass.

products.item_specific_return_policy: Must return both entangled doughnuts together.

products.description: Extremely hydrating alien cucumbers harvested from water-worlds.
